description: Effective-dated statutory retention periods for accounting records, vouchers, and commercial correspondence under AO § 147 / HGB § 257 (BEG IV)

classes.label: Books, records, inventories, annual financial statements
classes.notes: Requires primary check. AO § 147(1) Nr. 1, 4a, (3). Proposed 15-year extension bill is not enacted.

classes.label: Accounting vouchers (Buchungsbelege)
classes.notes: Requires primary check. Pre-BEG IV retention period for Buchungsbelege.

classes.label: Accounting vouchers (Buchungsbelege, BEG IV)
classes.notes: Requires primary check. Reduced from 10 to 8 years by BEG IV (AO § 147(1) Nr. 4, (3)).
